description:
My take on grit mentality ✨ It ain’t about the pain, or pushing, or trying harder.

It’s about BEING. Being in the process. Being in life. Growing when growing comes. Growing when growing needs to happen.

You can take life slow. There’s no hurry. Try the next thing. You don’t have to nail it. You don’t even have to do well.

Just learn something that doesn’t work. Then do that a few more times til you figure out something that DOES work. 

Keep living, keep being, KEEP GROWING.

Love you 💛

.

transcript: You don't get to start over, you never get to start over because all of your progress counts. Everything you've ever done has grown you into the person you are today and no one and nothing can take away who you fucking are. You don't get to start over because despite the fear, despite the pain, you have pushed and you have survived and it is impossible to undo the work you've done. Fuck starting over, keep growing!
